facts.fact: SUNA reports that on 11 May 2026 the ministries of health and of digital transformation and communications launched phase one of the health sector digitisation programme through the hospital management system (HMS), which includes an electronic patient record and an electronic medical record, at Al-Nao hospital in Khartoum state and the diagnostic centre of Gedaref hospital.

SUNA reports that phase one of the HMS started at two hospital sites, Al-Nao hospital in Khartoum state and the diagnostic centre of Gedaref hospital, ahead of gradual expansion to health institutions in other states; the report does not give the hospitals' level, and states a launch rather than routine use.

SUNA reports that the HMS programme was launched by the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications as their own programme; no vendor, partner or funding source is named.
